question: Who knows that all food is Maya-composed and Shiva is consumer?
premises: Shiva is consumer, and indeed I.
Who indeed knows thus is teacher and principle-crosser.
inference: Knowledge of this identity marks the teacher who crosses principles.
uncertainties: The exact first-person reference is compressed.
plain_english: All food is Maya-composed; Shiva is consumer, and indeed I; who indeed knows thus is teacher and principle-crosser.
